rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) proposes to conduct routine maintenance repairs to the existing Federal breakwater structures and associated anchoring systems. The repair work will preserve the structural and operational integrity of the Federal breakwater, which is essential for providing safe moorage and protection for vessels within Friday Harbor.
